correctness.rationale: Every projected cube-vertex displacement can be extended to a signed space diagonal without reducing squared projected length, so D²=3−min_signed(u1±u2±u3)²=3−(a−b−c)². Planar projected octahedron has one redundant opposite pair iff a>b+c, yielding N=4 for L>0 versus 6 for L<0. Forty-eight signed/ordered sphere chambers turn level sets of L into spherical arcs, giving density through coarea with two explicit endpoint branches. Mapping L→D produces stated joint densities, support sqrt2≤D≤sqrt3, N=6 only D≥sqrt(8/3), and endpoint asymptotics by arc slopes. Independent 1200-unit-normal tests compared formula to all 26 nonzero cube vertex differences; source checker additionally performs convex hull, density normalization and sampling.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks corroborate but do not replace the unrestricted argument.
